title: QueryPickupOrder
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Query Pickup Order.
html:
Request Address

GET/POST/pickup_order/query
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringYesAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
pickup_order_noStringYes揽收单号

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
resultObjectYesresult
  dataObjectYesdata
    reasonStringYes原因
    actual_arrive_timeStringYes实际送达时间
    shipper_nameStringYes发货人姓名
    update_timeNumberYes更新时间
    car_driver_nameStringYes司机姓名
    receive_store_codeStringYes收货仓库编码
    estimated_volumeStringYes预估体积(m3) {#.###}
    shipper_addressStringYes发货地址
    actual_pickup_timeStringYes实际揽收时间
    car_numberStringYes车牌号
    pickup_order_noStringYes揽收单号
    actual_weightStringYes实际重量(KG) {#.###}
    purchase_order_no_listString[]Yes关联发货单号列表
    shipper_phoneStringYes发货人联系方式
    estimated_weightStringYes预估重量(KG) {#.###}
    create_timeNumberYes创建时间
    estimated_box_numberNumberYes预估揽收箱数
    logistics_no_listString[]Yes关联物流单号列表
    estimated_pickup_timeNumberYes预约揽收上门日期
    receive_store_addressStringYes收货仓库地址
    car_driver_phoneStringYes司机联系电话
    statusStringYes揽收单状态code。10: 待揽收; 20: 已派车; 30: 已揽收; 40: 已送达; 50: 已完成; -10: 已取消; -20: 揽收失败; -30: 已删除;
    actual_logistics_no_listString[]No揽收真实物流单号
  successBooleanYestrue
  error_messageStringYeserror msg
  error_codeStringYeserror code
